name: Kanto in Motion
description: Kanto in Motion multi-generation HD Pokemon presentation and battle overhaul. Supports Red/Blue/Yellow, Gold/Silver/Crystal, and FireRed/LeafGreen/Ruby/Sapphire/Emerald; v1.7.0 expands the Gen 3 Modern UI across menus, Pokemon screens, naming, Trainer Card and battle presentation, and adds safer 1025Dex compatibility when expanded species remain in a save after the provider is disabled or removed.
